annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国矿产资源法实施条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations for the Implementation of the Mineral Resources Law of the People's Republic of China
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council of the People's Republic of China
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 839 issuing the Implementing Regulations of the PRC Mineral Resources Law, adopted 9 May 2026 and in force since 15 June 2026. It covers exploration and mining rights, licensing, renewals, ecological restoration, strategic mineral reserves and penalties. It does not deal with AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Exploration rights last 5 years and can be renewed up to 3 times
Mining rights last up to 30 years and can be renewed
Competitive transfer of mineral rights requires at least 30 working days of public notice
Mining-area ecological restoration is required, either during operations or within 2 years of mine closure
Sets fines for violations and repeals six earlier mineral administration rules
